entry.title: PHI Guard 3m v0.6 - Residual PHI Leak

link.title: PHI Guard 3m v0.6 - Residual PHI Leak

entry.content:
## Description PHI Guard 3m v0.6 scores de-identified clinical text for residual PHI that masking may have missed. It returns one document-level category per input document. It does not find or remove PHI, and a negative result does not certify privacy safety. Rounded size: about 3 million parameters. ## Predicted Entities `PHI_LEAK`, `NO_PHI_LEAK`, `UNKNOWN`, `REVIEW_REQUIRED` {:.btn-box} [Download](https://s3.amazonaws.com/auxdata.johnsnowlabs.com/clinical/models/phi_guard_3m_v0.6_en_7.0.1_3.4_1794590960461.zip){:.button.button-orange.button-orange-trans.arr.button-icon.hidden} [Copy S3 URI](s3://auxdata.johnsnowlabs.com/clinical/models/phi_guard_3m_v0.6_en_7.0.1_3.4_1794590960461.zip){:.button.button-orange.button-orange-trans.button-icon.button-copy-s3} ## How to use Load DecisionModel.pretrained("phi_guard_3m_v0.6", "en", "clinical/models"). Pass this name explicitly. Do not call setMode. Score the final de-identified note, not the original. The sample contrasts a masked note with Pt Maria Delgado, DOB 03/14/1956. Inspect result and metadata.status. A negative label is not a privacy certificate. The lookup name is lowercase.
{% include programmingLanguageSelectScalaPythonNLU.html %} ```python from pyspark.ml import Pipeline from sparknlp.base import DocumentAssembler import sparknlp_jsl from sparknlp_jsl.annotator.classification import DecisionModel spark = sparknlp_jsl.start() notes = spark.createDataFrame([ ("masked", "[NAME] visited [HOSPITAL] on [DATE]."), ("leaked", "Pt Maria Delgado, DOB 03/14/1956.")], ["case_id", "text"]) doc = DocumentAssembler().setInputCol("text").setOutputCol("document") guard = DecisionModel.pretrained("phi_guard_3m_v0.6", "en", "clinical/models")\ .setInputCols("document").setOutputCol("phi_leak") Pipeline(stages=[doc, guard]).fit(notes).transform(notes).selectExpr( "case_id", "phi_leak[0].result AS label", "phi_leak[0].metadata.status AS status" ).show(truncate=False) ``` ```scala import com.johnsnowlabs.nlp.DocumentAssembler import com.johnsnowlabs.nlp.annotators.classification.DecisionModel import org.apache.spark.ml.Pipeline import org.apache.spark.sql.SparkSession val spark = SparkSession.builder().getOrCreate() import spark.implicits._ val notes = Seq(("masked", "[NAME] visited [HOSPITAL] on [DATE]."), ("leaked", "Pt Maria Delgado, DOB 03/14/1956.")).toDF("case_id", "text") val doc = new DocumentAssembler().setInputCol("text").setOutputCol("document") val guard = DecisionModel.pretrained("phi_guard_3m_v0.6", "en", "clinical/models") .setInputCols("document").setOutputCol("phi_leak") new Pipeline().setStages(Array(doc, guard)).fit(notes).transform(notes).selectExpr( "case_id", "phi_leak[0].result AS label", "phi_leak[0].metadata.status AS status").show(false) ```
## Results ```bash +---------+-------------+--------+ | case_id | label | status | +---------+-------------+--------+ | masked | NO_PHI_LEAK | scored | | leaked | PHI_LEAK | scored | +---------+-------------+--------+ ``` {:.model-param} ## Model Information {:.table-model} |---|---| |Model Name:|phi_guard_3m_v0.6| |Compatibility:|Healthcare NLP 7.0.1+| |License:|Licensed| |Edition:|Official| |Input Labels:|[document]| |Output Labels:|[phi_guard]| |Language:|en| |Size:|12.0 MB| |Dependencies:|DocumentAssembler|

entry.title: PHI Guard 3m v0.7 - Multi-Task PHI Assessment

link.title: PHI Guard 3m v0.7 - Multi-Task PHI Assessment

entry.content:
## Description PHI Guard 3m v0.7 classifies clinical text for PHI presence in original notes, or residual PHI, harmful PHI, and exposure level after de-identification. Select one task per stage. ## Description Run the pipeline ## Predicted Entities `Lymph_Node`, `Histological_Type`, `Anatomical_Site`, `Staging`, `Imaging_Test`, `Tumor_Finding`, `Invasion`, `Response_To_Treatment`, `Adverse_Event`, `Tumor_Size`, `Biomarker_Result`, `Clinical_Condition`, `Chemotherapy`, `ICD10_Code`, `Targeted_Therapy`, `Radiotherapy`, `Performance_Status`, `Pathology_Test`, `Supportive_Care`, `Cancer_Surgery`, `Pathology_Result`, `Hormonal_Therapy`, `Biomarker`, `Immunotherapy`, `Metastasis`, `Cancer_Dx`, `Grade`, `Date`, `Treatment_Intent` {:.btn-box} [Download](https://s3.amazonaws.com/auxdata.johnsnowlabs.com/clinical/models/ner_cancer_registry_en_6.4.0_3.0_1790020084795.zip){:.button.button-orange.button-orange-trans.arr.button-icon.hidden} [Copy S3 URI](s3://auxdata.johnsnowlabs.com/clinical/models/ner_cancer_registry_en_6.4.0_3.0_1790020084795.zip){:.button.button-orange.button-orange-trans.button-icon.button-copy-s3} ## How to use
{% include programmingLanguageSelectScalaPythonNLU.html %} ```python document_assembler = DocumentAssembler()\ .setInputCol("text")\ .setOutputCol("document") sentence_detector = SentenceDetectorDLModel.pretrained("sentence_detector_dl_healthcare","en","clinical/models")\ .setInputCols(["document"])\ .setOutputCol("sentence") tokenizer = Tokenizer() \ .setInputCols(["sentence"]) \ .setOutputCol("token") word_embeddings = WordEmbeddingsModel().pretrained("embeddings_clinical", "en", "clinical/models")\ .setInputCols(["sentence", "token"]) \ .setOutputCol("embeddings") ner = MedicalNerModel.pretrained("ner_cancer_registry", "en", "clinical/models") \ .setInputCols(["sentence", "token", "embeddings"]) \ .setOutputCol("ner") ner_converter = NerConverter() \ .setInputCols(["sentence", "token", "ner"]) \ .setOutputCol("ner_chunk") pipeline = Pipeline(stages=[document_assembler, sentence_detector, tokenizer, word_embeddings, ner, ner_converter]) data = spark.createDataFrame([[""]]).toDF("text") model = pipeline.fit(data) ```
